h1.en: How Much Does IVF Cost in Washington in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta la FIV en Washington en 2026?

subhero.en: A single IVF cycle in Washington costs $12,750 to $21,700 for the base procedure at a Seattle-area fertility clinic in 2026, plus $3,000 to $7,000 for medications billed separately by a specialty pharmacy, for an all-in range of roughly $15,000 to $28,000 per cycle. Washington has no state law requiring health plans to cover IVF in 2026: the Building Families Act (HB 1129 and its companion SB 5121), which would have phased in fertility preservation coverage in 2026 and full infertility treatment coverage in 2027, died in the legislature on March 12, 2026. Washington's 2026 update to its Essential Health Benefits benchmark plan adds coverage for artificial insemination performed in vivo on small-group and individual market plans, but it explicitly excludes IVF and fertility preservation. This guide breaks down what Washington patients actually pay in 2026 and how to protect yourself with a written Good Faith Estimate.
subhero.es: Un solo ciclo de FIV en Washington cuesta de $12,750 a $21,700 por el procedimiento base en una clinica de fertilidad del area de Seattle en 2026, mas $3,000 a $7,000 por medicamentos facturados por separado por una farmacia especializada, con un costo total aproximado de $15,000 a $28,000 por ciclo. Washington no tiene una ley estatal que exija a los planes de salud cubrir la FIV en 2026: la Ley Building Families Act (HB 1129 y su version paralela SB 5121), que habria introducido gradualmente la cobertura de preservacion de fertilidad en 2026 y la cobertura completa del tratamiento de infertilidad en 2027, murio en la legislatura el 12 de marzo de 2026. La actualizacion de 2026 al plan de referencia de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de Washington agrega cobertura para la inseminacion artificial realizada in vivo en los planes de mercado individual y de grupo pequeno, pero excluye explicitamente la FIV y la preservacion de fertilidad.

quickAnswer.en: In Washington in 2026, one IVF cycle costs $12,750 to $21,700 for the base procedure at a standalone Seattle-area fertility clinic, plus $3,000 to $7,000 for injectable medications billed separately, for an all-in range of $15,000 to $28,000. Washington has no IVF insurance mandate: the proposed Building Families Act (HB 1129 and SB 5121) died on March 12, 2026, without passing. Apple Health, Washington's Medicaid program, does not cover IVF. Medicare does not cover IVF under any part of the program. Any Washington patient paying cash or who is uninsured has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before treatment under the federal No Surprises Act.
quickAnswer.es: En Washington en 2026, un ciclo de FIV cuesta de $12,750 a $21,700 por el procedimiento base en una clinica de fertilidad independiente del area de Seattle, mas $3,000 a $7,000 por medicamentos inyectables facturados por separado, con un costo total de $15,000 a $28,000. Washington no tiene mandato de seguro para la FIV: la propuesta Building Families Act (HB 1129 y SB 5121) murio el 12 de marzo de 2026 sin ser aprobada. Apple Health, el programa de Medicaid de Washington, no cubre la FIV. Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo ninguna parte del programa. Cualquier paciente de Washington que pague de su bolsillo o no tenga seguro tiene derecho a una Estimacion de Buena Fe por escrito antes del tratamiento bajo la Ley federal de No Sorpresas.

introParagraphs.en: In vitro fertilization is the most effective assisted reproductive technology available to patients facing infertility, and Washington patients pay entirely out of pocket for it in most cases in 2026. Washington lawmakers considered the Building Families Act, a bill (introduced as House Bill 1129 and companion Senate Bill 5121) that would have required group health plans, the state employee health plan, and Apple Health to phase in fertility preservation coverage starting January 1, 2026, followed by full infertility diagnosis and treatment coverage, including two egg retrievals with unlimited embryo transfers, starting January 1, 2027. The bill was reintroduced in January 2026 but was marked dead by the legislature on March 12, 2026, meaning it did not advance. Washington remains a state with no IVF insurance mandate in 2026, similar to the majority of states nationwide.
introParagraphs.es: La fecundacion in vitro es la tecnologia de reproduccion asistida mas efectiva disponible para los pacientes con infertilidad, y los pacientes de Washington pagan casi por completo de su bolsillo por ella en la mayoria de los casos en 2026. Los legisladores de Washington consideraron la Building Families Act, un proyecto de ley (presentado como House Bill 1129 y su acompanante Senate Bill 5121) que habria exigido a los planes de salud de grupo, al plan de salud de empleados estatales y a Apple Health introducir gradualmente la cobertura de preservacion de fertilidad a partir del 1 de enero de 2026, seguida de cobertura completa de diagnostico y tratamiento de infertilidad, incluyendo dos extracciones de ovulos con transferencias de embriones ilimitadas, a partir del 1 de enero de 2027. El proyecto fue reintroducido en enero de 2026 pero fue declarado muerto por la legislatura el 12 de marzo de 2026, lo que significa que no avanzo.

introParagraphs.en: A separate and unrelated change did take effect in Washington in 2026: the state's Essential Health Benefits benchmark plan, approved by CMS for plan year 2026, added coverage for artificial insemination performed in vivo (meaning fertilization that occurs inside the body, similar to intrauterine insemination), plus hearing aids and donor human milk, for small-group and individual market plans, including plans sold on Washington Healthplanfinder. This benchmark update does not add coverage for IVF or fertility preservation, which involve fertilization outside the body in a laboratory. Large-group plans and self-insured employer plans governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act are not required to follow the state benchmark at all. Confusing this in vivo insemination benefit with IVF coverage is a common and costly mistake for Washington patients researching their options in 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Un cambio separado y no relacionado si entro en vigor en Washington en 2026: el plan de referencia de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales del estado, aprobado por CMS para el ano del plan 2026, agrego cobertura para la inseminacion artificial realizada in vivo (es decir, fertilizacion que ocurre dentro del cuerpo, similar a la inseminacion intrauterina), ademas de audifonos y leche humana donada, para los planes de mercado individual y de grupo pequeno, incluidos los planes vendidos en Washington Healthplanfinder. Esta actualizacion del plan de referencia no agrega cobertura para la FIV ni la preservacion de fertilidad, que implican fertilizacion fuera del cuerpo en un laboratorio.

introParagraphs.en: Washington patients researching IVF costs in 2026 need a clear picture of what the procedure actually costs when self-paying, what the state's fertility coverage landscape does and does not require, what Medicare and Apple Health cover, the difference between standalone fertility clinics and hospital-affiliated academic programs, and their federal rights under the No Surprises Act to obtain a written Good Faith Estimate before any treatment begins. Patients who become pregnant through IVF should review how Apple Health handles pregnancy coverage and how ACA marketplace plans cover pregnancy for post-conception insurance options. Neighboring-state cost comparisons are available for patients weighing travel, including IVF cost guides for other states.
introParagraphs.es: Los pacientes de Washington que investigan los costos de FIV en 2026 necesitan una imagen clara de lo que realmente cuesta el procedimiento al pagar de su bolsillo, lo que el panorama de cobertura de fertilidad del estado exige y no exige, lo que cubren Medicare y Apple Health, la diferencia entre las clinicas de fertilidad independientes y los programas academicos afiliados a hospitales, y sus derechos federales bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas para obtener una Estimacion de Buena Fe por escrito antes de que comience cualquier tratamiento.

explanationParagraphs.en: Washington's 2026 IVF cost picture does not follow the typical pattern where hospital-affiliated programs always bill more than standalone clinics. Pacific Northwest Fertility, a standalone clinic with locations in Seattle, Kirkland, and Everett, publishes a base IVF fee of $14,500 to $21,700 in 2026. Pinnacle Fertility Washington, the practice formerly known as Seattle Reproductive Medicine, with locations across Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Everett, Tacoma, and Spokane, quotes $13,500 for a base cycle before medications or frozen embryo transfer. UW Medicine's University Reproductive Care program, based at a Seattle academic medical center, lists a comparatively lower base fee of $12,750. Whether a Washington quote runs high or low depends more on which components are bundled into the headline price than on whether the clinic is hospital-affiliated.
explanationParagraphs.es: El panorama de costos de FIV en Washington para 2026 no sigue el patron tipico en el que los programas afiliados a hospitales siempre cobran mas que las clinicas independientes. Pacific Northwest Fertility, una clinica independiente con sedes en Seattle, Kirkland y Everett, publica una tarifa base de FIV de $14,500 a $21,700 en 2026. Pinnacle Fertility Washington, la practica anteriormente conocida como Seattle Reproductive Medicine, con sedes en Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Everett, Tacoma y Spokane, cotiza $13,500 por un ciclo base antes de medicamentos o transferencia de embriones congelados.

explanationParagraphs.en: Medications are almost always billed separately from the procedure fee, charged directly by a specialty pharmacy with no connection to the clinic's quoted cycle price. Pacific Northwest Fertility estimates roughly $5,000 in medications for a full IVF cycle and roughly $2,000 for a frozen embryo transfer cycle. UW Medicine's lower base fee excludes monitoring visits, anesthesia, and cryopreservation, which appear as separate line items. Washington patients comparing quotes should request a fully itemized written estimate that covers monitoring ultrasounds and bloodwork, anesthesia for retrieval, embryology lab fees, the embryo transfer itself, and first-year embryo storage before assuming one clinic's headline number is actually cheaper than another's.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los medicamentos casi siempre se facturan por separado de la tarifa del procedimiento, cobrados directamente por una farmacia especializada sin conexion con el precio del ciclo cotizado por la clinica. Pacific Northwest Fertility estima aproximadamente $5,000 en medicamentos para un ciclo completo de FIV y aproximadamente $2,000 para un ciclo de transferencia de embriones congelados. La tarifa base mas baja de UW Medicine excluye visitas de monitoreo, anestesia y criopreservacion, que aparecen como partidas separadas.

explanationParagraphs.en: Multi-cycle discount programs exist at some Washington clinics for patients who expect to need more than one attempt. Pinnacle Fertility Washington offers two fixed-fee, multi-cycle programs for self-pay patients, one covering standard IVF and one covering frozen donor egg cycles, that bundle several attempts into a single upfront price. Spokane and the Inland Northwest are served primarily by the Center for Reproductive Health and a Pinnacle Fertility location, both of which typically price below the Seattle metro market. POMA Fertility, a physician-owned network with Washington locations, publishes its own treatment pricing separately.
explanationParagraphs.es: Existen programas de descuento de multiples ciclos en algunas clinicas de Washington para pacientes que esperan necesitar mas de un intento. Pinnacle Fertility Washington ofrece dos programas de tarifa fija de multiples ciclos para pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo, uno que cubre la FIV estandar y otro que cubre ciclos de ovulos donados congelados, que combinan varios intentos en un precio unico por adelantado. Spokane y el Inland Northwest son atendidos principalmente por el Center for Reproductive Health y una sede de Pinnacle Fertility, ambos con precios tipicamente por debajo del mercado metropolitano de Seattle.

paragraphs.en: Medicare does not cover IVF or other assisted reproductive technologies anywhere in the United States, including Washington. Original Medicare (Parts A and B) categorically excludes fertility treatments, meaning Medicare Part B covers no portion of the egg retrieval, embryo transfer, laboratory fees, or monitoring visits. Medicare Advantage (Part C) plans follow the same federal exclusion regardless of the plan or Washington carrier. Medicare Part D prescription drug plans do not cover injectable fertility stimulation medications such as gonadotropins, even when prescribed by a participating physician. The 2026 Part B deductible of $283 and the standard 20 percent coinsurance structure are not relevant to IVF because the procedure is excluded from Medicare coverage entirely. Medigap supplemental policies, which pay the 20 percent coinsurance on covered Medicare Part B services, provide no benefit for IVF because there is no underlying Medicare payment to supplement.
paragraphs.es: Medicare no cubre la FIV ni otras tecnologias de reproduccion asistida en ninguna parte de los Estados Unidos, incluyendo Washington. Medicare Original (Partes A y B) excluye categoricamente los tratamientos de fertilidad. Los planes Medicare Advantage (Parte C) siguen la misma exclusion federal sin importar la aseguradora de Washington. Los planes de medicamentos recetados de la Parte D de Medicare no cubren los medicamentos inyectables de estimulacion de fertilidad. El deducible de la Parte B de 2026 de $283 y el coseguro estandar del 20 por ciento no son relevantes para la FIV porque el procedimiento esta excluido por completo de la cobertura de Medicare. Las polizas suplementarias Medigap tampoco brindan ningun beneficio para la FIV porque no existe un pago subyacente de Medicare que complementar.

paragraphs.en: Apple Health, Washington's Medicaid program, does not cover IVF as of 2026. The Building Families Act, which would have added a fertility preservation benefit to Apple Health starting January 1, 2026 and comprehensive infertility diagnosis and treatment coverage to group and state employee plans starting January 1, 2027, was reintroduced in January 2026 but was marked dead by the legislature on March 12, 2026. Apple Health may cover medically necessary diagnostic infertility services, such as bloodwork, hormone panels, and pelvic ultrasounds, when ordered by a physician for a documented condition, but it does not reimburse egg retrieval, embryo transfer, or fertility medications. Washington patients enrolled in Apple Health who suspect a fertility issue should ask their OB-GYN or primary care provider to order covered diagnostic testing before exploring self-pay IVF options.
paragraphs.es: Apple Health, el programa de Medicaid de Washington, no cubre la FIV a partir de 2026. La Building Families Act, que habria agregado un beneficio de preservacion de fertilidad a Apple Health a partir del 1 de enero de 2026 y cobertura integral de diagnostico y tratamiento de infertilidad a los planes de grupo y de empleados estatales a partir del 1 de enero de 2027, fue reintroducida en enero de 2026 pero fue declarada muerta por la legislatura el 12 de marzo de 2026. Apple Health puede cubrir servicios diagnosticos de infertilidad medicamente necesarios, como analisis de sangre y ecografias pelvicas, cuando son ordenados por un medico para una condicion documentada, pero no reembolsa la extraccion de ovulos, la transferencia de embriones ni los medicamentos de fertilidad.

paragraphs.en: Washington's 2026 update to its Essential Health Benefits benchmark plan, approved by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, adds coverage for artificial insemination performed in vivo, along with hearing aids and donor human milk, for small-group and individual market ACA-compliant plans, including those sold on Washington Healthplanfinder, for plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2026. This benchmark change does not add coverage for IVF or for fertility preservation, both of which involve fertilization or gamete freezing outside the body. Large-group insured plans are not required to follow the state's Essential Health Benefits benchmark at all, and self-insured employer plans governed by the federal Employee Retirement Income Security Act can select any state's benchmark or none. USPSTF does not issue a preventive-care recommendation for IVF, so the ACA's free preventive-care mandate does not apply to it in Washington or anywhere else.
paragraphs.es: La actualizacion de 2026 al plan de referencia de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de Washington, aprobada por los Centros de Servicios de Medicare y Medicaid, agrega cobertura para la inseminacion artificial realizada in vivo, ademas de audifonos y leche humana donada, para los planes de mercado individual y de grupo pequeno con cumplimiento de la ACA, incluidos los vendidos en Washington Healthplanfinder, para anos de plan que comiencen a partir del 1 de enero de 2026. Este cambio de referencia no agrega cobertura para la FIV ni para la preservacion de fertilidad. El USPSTF no emite una recomendacion de atencion preventiva para la FIV, por lo que el mandato de atencion preventiva gratuita de la ACA no aplica a ella en Washington ni en ningun otro lugar.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any patient who is self-pay or uninsured has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before a scheduled medical service. For IVF in Washington, this federal protection applies regardless of the state's insurance mandate status. The Good Faith Estimate must itemize each expected charge: egg retrieval, embryology lab fees, anesthesia, the embryo transfer, and any add-ons such as preimplantation genetic testing or cryopreservation storage. For a Washington IVF cycle scheduled at least 10 business days out, the clinic must provide the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before the procedure. For appointments scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the estimate must arrive at least 1 business day before service. The federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact has the full consumer guidance and the dispute-filing process.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente que pague de su bolsillo o no tenga seguro tiene derecho a una Estimacion de Buena Fe por escrito antes de un servicio medico programado. Para la FIV en Washington, esta proteccion federal aplica independientemente del estado del mandato de seguro. La Estimacion de Buena Fe debe detallar cada cargo esperado: extraccion de ovulos, honorarios del laboratorio de embriologia, anestesia, la transferencia de embriones y cualquier adicional. Para un ciclo de FIV en Washington programado con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, la clinica debe entregar la Estimacion de Buena Fe al menos 3 dias habiles antes del procedimiento.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for an IVF cycle in Washington in 2026, follow these five steps. First, call the fertility clinic and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured before scheduling. Second, ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes every service component: monitoring ultrasounds and bloodwork, egg retrieval, anesthesia, embryology lab fees, embryo transfer, cryopreservation, and any planned add-ons such as preimplantation genetic testing or ICSI. Third, provide your ZIP code and ask about the clinic's contracted specialty pharmacy so you can compare medication prices. Fourth, confirm the timing: the clinic must deliver the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before the retrieval if scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. Fifth, keep the written Good Faith Estimate. If the final bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim within 120 days at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un ciclo de FIV en Washington en 2026, siga estos cinco pasos. Primero, llame a la clinica de fertilidad e identifiquese como paciente que paga de su bolsillo o sin seguro antes de programar la cita. Segundo, solicite una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita que detalle cada componente del servicio. Tercero, proporcione su codigo postal y pregunte sobre la farmacia especializada contratada por la clinica. Cuarto, confirme el plazo de entrega. Quinto, conserve la Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita. Si su factura final supera la estimacion en $400 o mas, presente una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas dentro de los 120 dias en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: A Good Faith Estimate for an IVF cycle is not a guaranteed final bill. Common reasons the actual charges exceed the estimate in Washington include additional monitoring visits when ovarian response requires extra ultrasounds, a change in anesthesia provider to one billing out of network, additional medication vials required by protocol, ICSI added at retrieval when fertilization rates run low, extra genetic testing ordered during the cycle, and embryo storage fees beyond the first year. If a Washington patient's final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, that patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim through the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact before paying the disputed amount.
paragraphs.es: Una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un ciclo de FIV no es una factura final garantizada. Las razones comunes por las que los cargos reales superan la estimacion en Washington incluyen visitas de monitoreo adicionales, un cambio de proveedor de anestesia fuera de la red, viales de medicamentos adicionales, ICSI agregado durante la extraccion y tarifas de almacenamiento de embriones mas alla del primer ano. Si la factura final de un paciente de Washington supera la Estimacion de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, ese paciente tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

items.en: Site of service and what is bundled into the quote. Washington clinic quotes range from $12,750 to $21,700 for the base cycle depending on whether monitoring, anesthesia, and cryopreservation are included or billed as separate line items.
items.es: Lugar de atencion y que esta incluido en la cotizacion. Las cotizaciones de las clinicas de Washington varian de $12,750 a $21,700 por el ciclo base segun si el monitoreo, la anestesia y la criopreservacion estan incluidos o se facturan como partidas separadas.

items.en: Number of cycles needed. Roughly 70 to 74 percent of patients nationally need more than one cycle to achieve a live birth, and each additional Washington attempt adds $15,000 to $28,000 or more to total out-of-pocket spending in 2026.
items.es: Numero de ciclos necesarios. Aproximadamente el 70 al 74 por ciento de los pacientes a nivel nacional necesita mas de un ciclo para lograr un nacimiento vivo, y cada intento adicional en Washington suma de $15,000 a $28,000 o mas al gasto total de bolsillo en 2026.

items.en: Independent clinic multi-cycle cash-pay bundles. Pinnacle Fertility Washington offers two fixed-fee multi-cycle programs for self-pay patients, one for standard IVF and one for frozen donor egg cycles, that can reduce the effective per-cycle cost 20 to 35 percent below paying for each attempt individually.
items.es: Paquetes de pago directo de multiples ciclos en clinicas independientes. Pinnacle Fertility Washington ofrece dos programas de tarifa fija de multiples ciclos para pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo, que pueden reducir el costo efectivo por ciclo entre un 20 y un 35 por ciento en comparacion con pagar cada intento individualmente.

items.en: Hospital or academic chargemaster discount ask. Patients treated through UW Medicine's University Reproductive Care program, part of a larger academic hospital system, should ask the financial counselor specifically about the hospital's published self-pay or chargemaster discount policy, which can reduce facility-billed components 20 to 50 percent for uninsured patients who ask before treatment begins.
items.es: Solicitud de descuento del precio lista hospitalario o academico. Los pacientes tratados a traves del programa University Reproductive Care de UW Medicine, parte de un sistema hospitalario academico mas grande, deben preguntar al consejero financiero especificamente sobre la politica de descuento de autopago o precio lista publicada del hospital, que puede reducir los componentes facturados por la instalacion entre un 20 y un 50 por ciento.

items.en: Medication assistance programs. ReUnite Rx, EMD Serono's Compassionate Care Program, and specialty pharmacy networks offer income-based discounts of 10 to 75 percent on injectable fertility medications for uninsured or self-pay Washington patients. Ask the clinic's financial counselor about enrollment before filling the first prescription.
items.es: Programas de asistencia con medicamentos. ReUnite Rx, el Programa de Atencion Compasiva de EMD Serono y las redes de farmacias especializadas ofrecen descuentos basados en ingresos del 10 al 75 por ciento en medicamentos inyectables de fertilidad para pacientes de Washington sin seguro o que pagan de su bolsillo.

items.en: Sliding-scale diagnostic services at Federally Qualified Health Centers. Washington community health centers, such as Neighborcare Health and Sea Mar Community Health Centers, offer sliding-scale diagnostic infertility workups by household income, but they do not perform IVF itself; they can provide the initial diagnostic workup before a referral to a fertility specialist.
items.es: Servicios diagnosticos de escala movil en Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente. Los centros de salud comunitarios de Washington, como Neighborcare Health y Sea Mar Community Health Centers, ofrecen evaluaciones diagnosticas de infertilidad con escala movil segun el ingreso familiar, pero no realizan la FIV en si.

items.en: Add-on costs. ICSI adds $1,000 to $2,500; preimplantation genetic testing adds $3,500 to $6,500 per cycle; donor egg cycles run $25,000 to $45,000 all-in because the donor's retrieval, compensation, and legal fees are included.
items.es: Costos adicionales. ICSI agrega de $1,000 a $2,500; la prueba genetica preimplantacional agrega de $3,500 a $6,500 por ciclo; los ciclos con ovulos donados cuestan de $25,000 a $45,000 todo incluido porque se incluyen la extraccion, compensacion y honorarios legales de la donante.

items.en: Employer voluntary fertility benefits. Several large Washington employers, particularly technology and aerospace companies in the Seattle metro area, voluntarily offer fertility benefits through administrators such as Progyny or Carrot Fertility, or through carrier-based riders such as Kaiser Permanente's fertility ART rider, on self-insured plans the state's Essential Health Benefits benchmark cannot reach. Check your employer's Summary of Benefits and ask HR specifically about a fertility benefit administrator.
items.es: Beneficios de fertilidad voluntarios del empleador. Varios grandes empleadores de Washington, particularmente empresas de tecnologia y aeroespacio en el area metropolitana de Seattle, ofrecen voluntariamente beneficios de fertilidad a traves de administradores como Progyny o Carrot Fertility, o mediante addendums de la aseguradora como el addendum de fertilidad ART de Kaiser Permanente.

intro.en: IVF billing in Washington is among the most complex in outpatient medicine, and the 2026 Essential Health Benefits change creates a new opportunity for confusion between what is and is not covered. Multiple providers, multiple dates of service, and parallel billing from the clinic, anesthesiologist, embryology lab, and specialty pharmacy create several opportunities for errors. Before paying any Washington IVF bill, check for these:
intro.es: La facturacion de la FIV en Washington es una de las mas complejas en la medicina ambulatoria, y el cambio de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de 2026 crea una nueva oportunidad de confusion. Antes de pagar cualquier factura de FIV en Washington, verifique lo siguiente:

items.en: A claim denied as excluded infertility treatment when the service billed was actually the artificial insemination in vivo benefit added to Washington's 2026 Essential Health Benefits benchmark. Ask the insurer to specify exactly which procedure code was billed and whether it qualifies for the new benchmark benefit before assuming the denial is correct.
items.es: Una reclamacion denegada como tratamiento de infertilidad excluido cuando el servicio facturado fue en realidad el beneficio de inseminacion artificial in vivo agregado al plan de referencia de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de Washington de 2026. Pida a la aseguradora que especifique exactamente que codigo de procedimiento se facturo.

items.en: Anesthesia billed separately and out of network when the patient had no opportunity to choose the anesthesiologist. Under the No Surprises Act, surprise out-of-network anesthesia bills for a scheduled procedure are disputable. Do not pay before checking network status.
items.es: Anestesia facturada por separado y fuera de la red cuando el paciente no tuvo la oportunidad de elegir al anestesiologo. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, las facturas sorpresa de anestesia fuera de la red por un procedimiento programado son disputables.

items.en: Monitoring ultrasounds billed at academic hospital facility rates when the monitoring was actually performed at a satellite clinic location that should bill at a lower rate.
items.es: Ecografias de monitoreo facturadas a tarifas de instalacion hospitalaria academica cuando el monitoreo se realizo en una ubicacion de clinica satelite que deberia facturar a una tarifa menor.

items.en: ICSI billed for all eggs retrieved when ICSI was performed on only a subset, or when standard insemination was actually used instead.
items.es: ICSI facturado por todos los ovulos extraidos cuando el ICSI solo se realizo en un subconjunto, o cuando en realidad se uso inseminacion estandar.

items.en: Embryo storage fees charged for the first year when cryopreservation storage is already included in the quoted cycle fee. Ask the clinic to specify what storage period is included in the base quote.
items.es: Tarifas de almacenamiento de embriones cobradas por el primer ano cuando el almacenamiento de criopreservacion ya esta incluido en la tarifa del ciclo cotizado.

items.en: Final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more without explanation. Under federal law, the patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Do not pay the excess before disputing.
items.es: La factura final supera la Estimacion de Buena Fe en $400 o mas sin explicacion. Bajo la ley federal, el paciente tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas. No pague el exceso antes de disputarlo.

en.question: How much does IVF cost in Washington without insurance in 2026?
en.answer: A single IVF cycle in Washington costs $12,750 to $21,700 for the base procedure at a standalone or academic fertility clinic, plus $3,000 to $7,000 for injectable medications billed separately by a specialty pharmacy. The all-in range is roughly $15,000 to $28,000 per cycle. Pacific Northwest Fertility publishes a base fee of $14,500 to $21,700. Pinnacle Fertility Washington quotes $13,500 before medications. UW Medicine's University Reproductive Care lists a comparatively lower $12,750 base fee. If you need multiple cycles, which is common, total costs frequently exceed $40,000.

en.question: Does Washington require insurance to cover IVF in 2026?
en.answer: No. Washington has no state law requiring health insurers to cover IVF as of 2026. The Building Families Act (House Bill 1129 and companion Senate Bill 5121), which would have phased in fertility preservation coverage in 2026 and full infertility treatment coverage including IVF in 2027, was reintroduced in January 2026 but was marked dead by the legislature on March 12, 2026. Washington's separate 2026 Essential Health Benefits benchmark update adds coverage only for artificial insemination performed in vivo, hearing aids, and donor human milk on small-group and individual market plans, not IVF.

en.question: Does Medicare cover IVF in Washington?
en.answer: No. Medicare does not cover IVF under any part of the program anywhere in the country, including Washington. This applies to Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and Medicare Part D prescription drug plans. Injectable fertility medications such as gonadotropins are also excluded from Part D coverage. Medicare beneficiaries pursuing IVF in Washington pay entirely out of pocket. The 2026 Part B deductible of $283 and 20 percent coinsurance apply only to covered services, and IVF is not a covered service.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for an IVF cycle in Washington?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act, any self-pay or uninsured patient has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before treatment. Call the Washington fertility clinic and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured. Ask for a written estimate itemizing egg retrieval, anesthesia, embryology lab fees, monitoring, embryo transfer, cryopreservation, and any planned add-ons. If the cycle is scheduled at least 10 business days out, the clinic must provide the estimate at least 3 business days before service. Keep the estimate. If your final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact within 120 days of the bill date.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to IVF in Washington?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act is a federal law that took effect January 1, 2022. For self-pay and uninsured patients, it requires providers and facilities to furnish a written Good Faith Estimate of expected charges before a scheduled service. The law applies to all providers and facilities in Washington, including fertility clinics, regardless of whether Washington has an IVF insurance mandate. If a Washington patient's final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, that patient has 120 days from the bill date to dispute it through the federal patient-provider dispute resolution portal.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for IVF in Washington?
en.answer: Call two or three Washington fertility clinics before committing to any treatment. Ask each one for the self-pay or cash-pay price, and ask specifically whether the quoted amount includes monitoring ultrasounds and bloodwork, anesthesia, embryology lab fees, the embryo transfer, and first-year embryo storage. UW Medicine's lower headline price, for example, may exclude components that Pacific Northwest Fertility bundles in. Get all quotes in writing as a Good Faith Estimate so you can compare them accurately, and ask about multi-cycle bundled pricing if you may need more than one attempt.

en.question: Can I negotiate an IVF bill after the fact in Washington?
en.answer: Yes. Patients who have already received a bill can negotiate, particularly self-pay amounts. If your final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact within 120 days of the bill date. Outside the formal dispute process, many Washington fertility clinics and hospital financial counselors accept cash-pay-now offers at a discount of 20 to 40 percent below the billed chargemaster rate. Ask to speak with a financial counselor, state that you are self-pay, and request their best cash settlement offer.

en.question: What is the difference between hospital and independent clinic IVF cost in Washington?
en.answer: Unlike many states, Washington does not show a strict hospital-more-expensive pattern. UW Medicine's University Reproductive Care, an academic hospital-affiliated program, publishes a lower base fee of $12,750 than several independent clinics. Pacific Northwest Fertility, a standalone practice, quotes $14,500 to $21,700. The difference usually comes down to what each quote bundles: academic programs may exclude monitoring, anesthesia, or cryopreservation as separate charges, while independent clinics sometimes fold more components into a single price. Always request a fully itemized written quote to compare true totals rather than headline base fees.

en.question: Does Apple Health or an ACA-compliant plan cover IVF in Washington?
en.answer: Apple Health, Washington's Medicaid program, does not cover IVF in 2026. ACA-compliant individual market plans sold through Washington Healthplanfinder are also not required to cover IVF; the state's 2026 Essential Health Benefits benchmark update added coverage only for artificial insemination performed in vivo, hearing aids, and donor human milk. USPSTF does not issue a preventive-care recommendation for IVF, so the ACA's free preventive-care mandate does not apply. Large-group and self-insured employer plans are unaffected by the state benchmark and may or may not offer fertility benefits voluntarily.

en.question: What is the difference between IVF and IUI, and which costs more in Washington?
en.answer: IUI, or intrauterine insemination, is a much simpler and lower-cost fertility procedure than IVF. IUI places prepared sperm directly into the uterus around ovulation and does not involve egg retrieval, embryo creation, or an embryology lab phase. In Washington, a monitored IUI cycle with medications typically costs $800 to $2,500 all-in, compared to $15,000 to $28,000 for IVF. Notably, Washington's 2026 Essential Health Benefits benchmark now requires small-group and individual market plans to cover artificial insemination performed in vivo, which can include IUI, while IVF remains uncovered on those same plans.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta la FIV en Washington sin seguro en 2026?
es.answer: Un solo ciclo de FIV en Washington cuesta de $12,750 a $21,700 por el procedimiento base en una clinica independiente o academica, mas $3,000 a $7,000 por medicamentos inyectables facturados por separado. El rango total por ciclo es de aproximadamente $15,000 a $28,000. Pacific Northwest Fertility publica una tarifa base de $14,500 a $21,700. Pinnacle Fertility Washington cotiza $13,500 antes de medicamentos. UW Medicine lista una tarifa base comparativamente mas baja de $12,750. Si necesita multiples ciclos, los costos totales frecuentemente superan los $40,000.

es.question: Washington exige que el seguro cubra la FIV en 2026?
es.answer: No. Washington no tiene una ley estatal que exija a las aseguradoras cubrir la FIV a partir de 2026. La Building Families Act (House Bill 1129 y su version paralela Senate Bill 5121), que habria introducido gradualmente la cobertura de preservacion de fertilidad en 2026 y la cobertura completa de tratamiento de infertilidad incluyendo la FIV en 2027, fue reintroducida en enero de 2026 pero fue declarada muerta por la legislatura el 12 de marzo de 2026. La actualizacion separada de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de 2026 de Washington agrega cobertura solo para inseminacion artificial in vivo, audifonos y leche humana donada.

es.question: Medicare cubre la FIV en Washington?
es.answer: No. Medicare no cubre la FIV bajo ninguna parte del programa en ningun lugar del pais, incluyendo Washington. Esto aplica a Medicare Original, Medicare Advantage y los planes de medicamentos de la Parte D. Los medicamentos inyectables de fertilidad tambien estan excluidos de la cobertura de la Parte D. Los beneficiarios de Medicare que realizan FIV en Washington pagan completamente de su bolsillo. El deducible de la Parte B de 2026 de $283 y el coseguro del 20 por ciento aplican solo a los servicios cubiertos.

es.question: Como solicito una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un ciclo de FIV en Washington?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier paciente que pague de su bolsillo o no tenga seguro tiene derecho a una Estimacion de Buena Fe por escrito antes del tratamiento. Llame a la clinica de fertilidad de Washington e identifiquese como paciente que paga de su bolsillo. Solicite una estimacion escrita que detalle la extraccion de ovulos, anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio, monitoreo, transferencia de embriones y criopreservacion. Si el ciclo esta programado con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, la clinica debe entregar la estimacion al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica a la FIV en Washington?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas es una ley federal vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022. Para pacientes que pagan de su bolsillo o sin seguro, exige que los proveedores den una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita de los cargos esperados antes de un servicio programado. La ley aplica a todos los proveedores en Washington, incluyendo las clinicas de fertilidad, independientemente de si Washington tiene un mandato de seguro de FIV. Si la factura final supera la estimacion en $400 o mas, el paciente tiene 120 dias para disputarla.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de pago directo para la FIV en Washington?
es.answer: Llame a dos o tres clinicas de fertilidad de Washington antes de comprometerse con algun tratamiento. Pregunte a cada una el precio de autopago, y pregunte especificamente si el monto cotizado incluye ecografias de monitoreo, anestesia, honorarios de laboratorio, la transferencia de embriones y el almacenamiento del primer ano. Obtenga todas las cotizaciones por escrito como una Estimacion de Buena Fe para poder compararlas con precision, y pregunte sobre precios combinados de multiples ciclos si podria necesitar mas de un intento.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de FIV despues de recibirla en Washington?
es.answer: Si. Los pacientes que ya han recibido una factura pueden negociar, particularmente los montos de autopago. Si su factura final supera la Estimacion de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, presente una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas en cms.gov/nosurprisesact dentro de los 120 dias posteriores a la fecha de la factura. Fuera del proceso formal de disputa, muchas clinicas de fertilidad y consejeros financieros de hospitales de Washington aceptan ofertas de pago al contado con descuentos del 20 al 40 por ciento por debajo de la tarifa del precio lista facturado.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre la FIV en un hospital y en una clinica independiente en Washington?
es.answer: A diferencia de muchos estados, Washington no muestra un patron estricto en el que el hospital siempre cuesta mas. University Reproductive Care de UW Medicine, un programa academico afiliado a un hospital, publica una tarifa base mas baja de $12,750 que varias clinicas independientes. Pacific Northwest Fertility, una practica independiente, cotiza de $14,500 a $21,700. La diferencia generalmente depende de lo que incluye cada cotizacion. Siempre solicite una cotizacion detallada por escrito para comparar los totales reales.

es.question: Apple Health o un plan con cumplimiento de la ACA cubren la FIV en Washington?
es.answer: Apple Health, el programa de Medicaid de Washington, no cubre la FIV en 2026. Los planes de mercado individual con cumplimiento de la ACA vendidos a traves de Washington Healthplanfinder tampoco estan obligados a cubrir la FIV; la actualizacion de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de 2026 del estado agrego cobertura solo para inseminacion artificial in vivo, audifonos y leche humana donada. El USPSTF no emite una recomendacion de atencion preventiva para la FIV, por lo que el mandato de atencion preventiva gratuita de la ACA no aplica.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre FIV e IUI, y cual cuesta mas en Washington?
es.answer: La IIU, o inseminacion intrauterina, es un procedimiento de fertilidad mucho mas simple y de menor costo que la FIV. La IIU coloca espermatozoides preparados directamente en el utero y no implica extraccion de ovulos ni una fase de laboratorio de embriologia. En Washington, un ciclo monitoreado de IIU con medicamentos tipicamente cuesta de $800 a $2,500 todo incluido, en comparacion con $15,000 a $28,000 para la FIV. La actualizacion de Beneficios de Salud Esenciales de 2026 de Washington ahora exige que los planes de mercado individual y de grupo pequeno cubran la inseminacion artificial in vivo, que puede incluir la IIU, mientras que la FIV permanece sin cobertura en esos mismos planes.

numberedSteps: Call the Washington fertility clinic and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured before scheduling the retrieval.

Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes every component: monitoring ultrasounds and bloodwork, egg retrieval fee, anesthesia, embryology lab fees, embryo transfer, cryopreservation, and any planned add-ons such as PGT or ICSI.
Provide your ZIP code and ask the clinic for their contracted specialty pharmacy so you can compare injectable medication prices directly.

Confirm the delivery timing: the clinic must provide the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before the retrieval if scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out.

Keep the written Good Faith Estimate in a secure location. If your final bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
